mapper.select: SELECT /* LGVPAYP0014.retrieveQualificationList */ a.employee_no , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(a.qlfc_acquisition_yyyymmdd, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'DD/MM/YYY') AS acquisition_date , b.common_code_name AS qualification FROM tb_pay_emp_certification_acq_n a , lgcom_common_code_multi_lang_c b , lgcom_common_code_c c WHERE c.code_type_code = 'LGVPAY_QUALIFICATION_TYPE_CODE' AND c.common_code = a.qualification_type_id AND b.language_code = #{USER_SESSION.languageCode} AND c.code_type_code = b.code_type_code AND c.common_code = b.common_code AND a.employee_no = #{employeeNo} ORDER BY c.code_data2_value DESC
